tasks.verified: An independent 49-combination Monday-anchored matrix (7 weekdays x 7 base days) driven directly against the edited resolver, the exact reported bug spot-checked, untouched paths proven unchanged, and the full existing gateway suite green so the CVC-shared code cannot regress.
tasks.spec:
Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the cvc-booking-gateway repo. Edit files here directly. Never git commit, never push, never call an API, never deploy. This file serves BOTH Mott and CVC live patients, so the existing test suite must stay green.

THE BUG. container/bland_gateway.py has a date resolver, resolve_relative_date, starting near line 475. It converts English/Chinese date phrases to MM/DD/YYYY for the scheduler. The owner rule: a week qualifier means the calendar week AFTER the current one, Monday-anchored. Measured against the live gateway on Monday 2026-07-27, 'monday next week' resolved to 08/10 (fourteen days out) when the owner target is 08/03 (the next Monday, seven days out). The broken set grows through the week and fails 21 of 49 weekday/base-day combinations.

ROOT CAUSE, confirmed by a four-lane review panel. Line ~577-580:
  match = re.fullmatch(rf"(?:a week from ({weekday_pattern})|({weekday_pattern}) next week)", t)
  if match:
      weekday_text = match.group(1) or match.group(2)
      return emit(next_weekday(_WEEKDAYS[weekday_text]) + timedelta(days=7))
next_weekday() returns the NEXT FUTURE occurrence (never today) and adds 7, which double-counts on and near Monday.

THE FIX, using a function THAT ALREADY EXISTS in this file. calendar_weekday(weekday, weeks_ahead) at line ~500 computes Monday of the current week plus weeks_ahead weeks plus the weekday offset. It is already the correct primitive and is already used by the Chinese path at line ~565, which has always been right.
(1) Line ~580: replace `next_weekday(_WEEKDAYS[weekday_text]) + timedelta(days=7)` with `calendar_weekday(_WEEKDAYS[weekday_text], 1)`. This covers both 'a week from <weekday>' and '<weekday> next week'.
(2) Line ~576: the '<weekday> after next' branch currently does `next_weekday(...) + timedelta(days=7)`. Change it to `calendar_weekday(_WEEKDAYS[match.group(1)], 2)` so it means the weekday in the second-next calendar week. The panel confirmed this branch has the same defect.
(3) Update the explanatory comment near line ~481 that describes 'weekday-plus-week phrases use the next future weekday plus seven days'; it is now factually stale. State the calendar-anchored behavior instead.

DO NOT TOUCH: line ~520 'next weekend'. The panel ruled it a separate owner judgment call (English 'next weekend' is ambiguous when today is Sat/Sun) and it is out of scope for this fix. Leave it exactly as is. Do not change bare-weekday resolution, the Chinese paths, the 'in N weeks' paths, or anything else.

TESTS. The existing tests/test_date_resolver.py is pinned to a Wednesday base date (07/22), and Wednesday is one of the days the buggy and correct arithmetic AGREE, so it is blind to this bug. Add exhaustive parametrized cases that pin the base date to a MONDAY (use whatever mechanism the existing tests use to set 'today'; the resolver reads _eastern_today) and assert '<weekday> next week' and '<weekday> after next' for all seven weekdays, since Monday is where the divergence is maximal. Keep every existing test case unchanged and passing.

VERIFY before finishing: run the grading check yourself: python3 /mnt/d_drive/repos/mott/gw-temporal-check/check_gw_temporal.py --gateway container/bland_gateway.py --repo . It drives all 49 combinations independently and runs the existing suite. It must print CHECK PASSED.

Deliver the edited container/bland_gateway.py and tests/test_date_resolver.py. Also write a short report to ./TEMPORAL-FIX-REPORT.md: what changed, why, the before/after for the two branches, and confirmation the existing suite is green. Under 400 words.
